_comment: Template. Copy to pipeline.<env>.json in this folder (e.g. pipeline.dev.json; gitignored) and set "env" to the same name. Each file adds that env to the make consolidated-pipeline menu. Stages run in order; the run stops at the first failure. Each stage's mode is that module's mode (currency-database-load: daily|historical; ledger-sheet-load: sheet-sync|sheet-rebuild; ledger-sheet-extract: normal-sync|hard-sync). A sheet-rebuild stage also needs "confirm" set to the env name.
